items.name: Vincenzo
items.description: The original white mouse hunter with two red spots.

items.name: Luna
items.description: A sleek black cat with golden eyes. Silent as the night.

items.name: Tigro
items.description: A fiery orange tabby who loves the chase.

items.name: Nuvola
items.description: A fluffy grey cloud of a cat with icy blue eyes.

items.name: Biscotto
items.description: A cream-colored cookie cat with chocolate spots.

items.name: Bubblegum
items.description: A bright pink legend with purple spots. Very rare!

items.name: Rosa
items.description: A snow-white beauty without a single spot. Elegant and lightning fast.

items.name: Ivar
items.description: A mysterious black cat with bold white stripes. The terror of every mouse!

items.name: Peppino
items.description: A legendary orange cat with bright white stripes. The pride of every alley!

items.name: Mirtillo
items.description: A blueberry-blue cat with dark navy spots and golden eyes.

items.name: Caramella
items.description: A sweet caramel cat with creamy white spots.

items.name: Ombra
items.description: A smoky shadow cat without a single spot. Mice never see her coming!

items.name: Pistacchio
items.description: A pistachio-green cat with dark green stripes. Totally unique!

items.name: Fulmine
items.description: A lightning-yellow cat with black stripes. Fast as a thunderbolt!

items.name: Nebbia
items.description: A misty silver cat with soft grey stripes and lilac eyes.

items.name: Marshmallow
items.description: A fluffy pastel-pink cat with sky-blue spots.

items.name: Cosmo
items.description: A deep-space purple cat with starry spots. Made for the spaceship!

items.name: Lava
items.description: A volcanic black cat with glowing orange stripes. Too hot to handle!

items.name: Oro
items.description: The legendary golden cat, shining like a golden mouse. The most expensive cat in the shop!

items.name: Zoomies
items.description: Run 1.6x faster for 20 seconds. Press 1 during the hunt.

items.name: Double Brokjes
items.description: Every mouse gives 2x brokjes for 20 seconds. Press 2 during the hunt.

items.name: Triple Brokjes
items.description: Every mouse gives 3x brokjes for 20 seconds. Press 3 during the hunt.

items.name: Golden Mice
items.description: Turns every mouse into a golden mouse for 30 seconds. Golden mice are faster, but worth lots of brokjes! Press 4 during the hunt.

items.name: Lucky Clover
items.description: For 25 seconds, new mice are very often golden (up to 3 at a time). Press 5 during the hunt.

items.name: Magnet Paws
items.description: Catch mice from almost twice as far away for 20 seconds. Press 6 during the hunt.

items.name: Sleepy Mice
items.description: All mice get sleepy and move at less than half speed for 20 seconds. Press 7 during the hunt.

items.name: Cheese Lure
items.description: The mice are so busy sniffing cheese that they don't run away from you for 15 seconds. Press 8 during the hunt.

items.name: Extra Time
items.description: Adds 30 seconds to the hunt clock right away. Press 9 during a level (not needed in endless mode).

items.name: Mouse Party
items.description: 4 extra mice join the room for 25 seconds: more mice, more brokjes! Press 0 during the hunt.

items.name: Pepper Sneeze
items.description: 3 mighty sneezes. Press E: every mouse you can see on screen is knocked out instantly!

items.name: Brokjes Blaster
items.description: A toy blaster that zaps mice from far away. Comes with 10 pellets. Press F to fire.

items.name: Brokjes Pellets
items.description: 10 glowing pellets for the Brokjes Blaster.

items.name: Yarn Ball Bomb
items.description: 3 bouncy yarn balls. Press G to throw one ahead: every mouse near where it lands gets tangled up!

items.name: Cheesy Mouse Traps
items.description: 5 traps with cheese. Press T to put one down: nearby mice come sniffing and get caught!

items.name: Super Squirter
items.description: A water gun that sprays a wide splash in front of you and soaks every mouse it hits. Comes with 15 squirts. Press R to spray.

items.name: Water Refill
items.description: 15 squirts for the Super Squirter.

items.name: Top Hat
items.description: Very fancy. Very gentlecat.

items.name: Party Hat
items.description: Every catch is a celebration!

items.name: Golden Crown
items.description: For the true king (or queen) of the house.

items.name: Samurai Helmet
items.description: A shiny red samurai kabuto with golden horns. Honor to the mouse hunter!

items.name: Wizard Beard
items.description: A long white beard full of ancient mouse-hunting wisdom.

items.name: Moustache
items.description: A curly black moustache. Magnifico!

items.name: Cool Shades
items.description: Too cool for the mice to handle.

items.name: Bow Tie
items.description: A smart blue bow tie for formal hunts.

items.name: Cozy Scarf
items.description: A warm striped scarf for the chilly attic.

items.name: Cowboy Hat
items.description: Yee-haw! The sheriff of mouse town.

items.name: Pirate Hat
items.description: Arrr! Perfect for hunting mice on the boat.

items.name: Wizard Hat
items.description: A starry hat full of mouse-catching magic.

items.name: Chef Hat
items.description: The master chef of the kitchen (mice not on the menu... or are they?).

items.name: Viking Helmet
items.description: A shiny helmet with big horns for a brave warrior cat.

items.name: Propeller Cap
items.description: A rainbow beanie with a spinning propeller on top.

items.name: Space Helmet
items.description: A see-through space helmet. Ready for the spaceship!

items.name: Golden Monocle
items.description: Very distinguished. Very detective.

items.name: Pirate Eye Patch
items.description: One eye is enough to spot a mouse.

items.name: Clown Nose
items.description: Honk honk! The mice will laugh themselves silly.

items.name: Heart Glasses
items.description: Pink heart-shaped glasses. Love at first sight!

items.name: Gold Medal
items.description: For the champion mouse hunter.

items.name: Bandana
items.description: A red polka-dot bandana, cowboy style.

items.name: Super Cape
items.description: A red superhero cape. Super-Cat to the rescue!

items.name: Butterfly Wings
items.description: Sparkly purple wings. Can't really fly, but look amazing.

items.name: Surprise Box
items.description: What's inside? Could be a cat, clothes, a weapon or a boost!
